properties.description:

Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will fall below 6.5 ft after the

properties.areaDesc: San Luis Obispo County Mountains; Santa Barbara County Interior Mountains
properties.headline: Fire Weather Watch issued October 13 at 1:49PM PDT until October 16 at 6:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
***CORRECTED SYNOPSIS***

...HIGH RISK FOR EXTREME FIRE BEHAVIOR WITH ANY NEW FIRE STARTS
THURSDAY THROUGH FRIDAY DUE TO MODERATE TO LOCALLY STRONG SANTA
ANA WINDS AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY...

.Moderate to locally strong Santa Ana winds will quickly develop
on Thursday, peak Thursday afternoon through Friday afternoon,
then weaken through the weekend. Meanwhile, dry air will settle
over the region and dry out any helpful effects of the recent
rains. The previous Fire Weather Watches were upgraded to Red Flag
Warnings. Some of the windiest areas may see Red Flag conditions
linger into Saturday. As the winds expand Thursday Night into
Friday, Red Flag conditions may form over the interior mountains
of Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo Counties on Friday, where a
Fire Weather Watch is now in effect.

* AFFECTED AREA...San Luis Obispo County Mountains and Santa
Barbara County Interior Mountains.

* TIMING...From Friday morning through Friday afternoon.

* WINDS...East 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Minimums of 8 to 20 percent common.

* IMPACTS...If fire ignition occurs, conditions are favorable
for extreme fire behavior which would threaten life and
property.
properties.instruction:
A Fire Weather Watch means that critical fire weather conditions
are likely to occur in the coming days. Residents near wildland
interfaces should prepare now on what to do if a wildfire breaks
out. See readyforwildfire.org and wildfirerisk.org for
information.

properties.areaDesc: Ventura County Beaches
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 13 at 1:27PM PDT until October 15 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor tidal overflow during times of high tides,
dangerous rip currents, and elevated surf.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, through Thursday
afternoon. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 2 PM PDT this
afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding of sea water is likely around high
tide at low-lying beach and harbor areas that is uncommon with
normal tidal ranges. Enhanced beach erosion is possible. The
risk for significant damage is very low. There is an increased
risk of ocean drowning. Rip currents can pull swimmers and
surfers out to sea. Waves can wash people off beaches and rocks,
and capsize small boats nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor tidal overflow during morning high
tides of 6.5 to 7.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 13 at 1:21PM MST until October 17 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...East to southeast winds 30 to 35 mph with gusts 50-60 mph
are expected. The strongest winds may be focused immediately
downstream of the higher terrain, and along terrain gaps and
east-west oriented valleys Friday morning.

* WHERE...A portion of Southeast Arizona.

* WHEN...From 11 PM Thursday to 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Strong and gusty winds over desert areas could result in
blowing dust, briefly lowering visibility below a mile at times.
Difficult driving conditions will be present, especially for larger
vehicles traveling along roadways with strong and gusty crosswinds.
Light, unsecured objects such as trash cans and yard decorations
may be blown around. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power
outages may result.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
